b3f062a8756254112d3371b0a687ce51c4af9d12.pinyin: nǐ de hán jià zěn me guo de?

b3f16ccd665ae5b3cb60b6160bee6c693f0f382e.pinyin: wǒ men bì xū shǐ zhōng wèi zāi hài zuò hǎo zhǔn bèi.
b3f16ccd665ae5b3cb60b6160bee6c693f0f382e.text: 我们必须始终为灾害做好准备。

b3f4eece4f0210bc1aabc86a3360c07b830e8b24.pinyin: tā men qīng chén chū fā, xià wǔ dǐ dá tún liú.
b3f4eece4f0210bc1aabc86a3360c07b830e8b24.text: 他们清晨出发，下午抵达屯留。

b3f578615bb648d42568894059d23845f83fdfd8.pinyin: yuǎn chù yǒu láng áo áo de jiào.

b3f6dfcf02bff274e0726644bfa78a780550a12a.pinyin: lì lǜ hé tōng huò péng zhàng hěn gāo.

b3fa127b578146c51c338f5caebb7ac964bd227d.pinyin: tā men shōu yǎng le nà ge gū ér.

b3fce7f1f1c8697a9e8fe2efa17fd43fb16e8eeb.pinyin: zhè wèi jiàn duō shí guǎng de xiàng dǎo bāng zhù wǒ men liǎo jiě dāng dì wén huà.
b3fce7f1f1c8697a9e8fe2efa17fd43fb16e8eeb.text: 这位见多识广的向导帮助我们了解当地文化。

b3fe8a5b2865b3fc5d123b47456235a8914b0971.pinyin: cūn mín zhèng zài jiàn shè xīn de dào lù.
b3fe8a5b2865b3fc5d123b47456235a8914b0971.text: 村民正在建设新的道路。

b3ffb6af9272f422b1cef9c1bfcedda15c34f1be.pinyin: tǐ yù chǎng pí lín xué xiào.
